# Edusaas — Education SaaS & Institutional ERP Platform

> Edusaas (https://edusaas.global) is an enterprise-grade Multi-Tenant Educational SaaS & ERP platform designed for schools, madrasas, colleges, academies, and multi-branch educational institutes in Bangladesh and internationally.

## Overview
- **Brand**: Edusaas (also known as EduSaaS Global)
- **Website**: https://edusaas.global
- **Business Category**: Educational SaaS / School & Madrasa Management ERP Software
- **Headquarters**: Dhaka, Bangladesh
- **Official Contact**: contact@edusaas.global | Phone/WhatsApp: +8801576600265
- **Architecture**: Next.js 16 App Router, Supabase PostgreSQL with Row Level Security (RLS), multi-tenant isolation, and multi-provider AI adapters.

## Core Capabilities & Modules
1. **Biometric Attendance Integration**:
   - Hardware bridge for ZKTeco and standard fingerprint & facial recognition devices.
   - Real-time cloud synchronization, automatic 1-minute deduplication, and automated Bengali SMS notification to parents upon student arrival and departure.
2. **Automated Examination & Grading Engine**:
   - Subject-wise marks tabulation, automatic percentage calculation, GPA & letter grade assignment, section/class merit rankings, and printable marksheets with QR verification.
3. **Paperless Student Fee Management & Accounting**:
   - Double-entry institutional accounting ledger, fee schedules, automated SMS dues reminders, digital fee receipts with QR validation, and boarding expense tracking.
4. **Online Admission Portal & Student Registry**:
   - Customizable digital admission forms, document uploads, student profile management, and automatic ID generation.
5. **No-Code White-Label Dynamic Website Builder**:
   - Enables independent madrasas and schools to deploy custom white-label websites on their own custom domains (e.g., your-institution.edu.bd) within minutes.
6. **Nur AI Quran Companion & Interactive Teaching Engine**:
   - Integrated AI Quran learning tutor providing voice recitation evaluation, 17 Makharij anatomical articulation guidance, Tajweed rules (Noon Saakin, Meem Saakin, Madd, Qalqalah), and Hifz memorization tracking.

## Target Institutions
- General Schools & Colleges (Bangla Medium and English Version)
- Islamic Madrasas (Noorani, Najera, Hifzul Quran, Kitabkhana, and Dawra-e-Hadith)
- Training Academies and Multi-Branch Educational Chains

## Security & Multi-Tenant Isolation
- Strict server-side tenant resolution via cryptographic session tokens or validated Host headers.
- Zero-Trust database isolation enforced via PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS).
- Write-once immutable audit logging for administrative actions and security anomalies.
- Zero credential logging and timing-safe API secret validation.
